name: pencil-md
description: Publish markdown pages and canvas drawings to pencil.md, share the links, and keep editing them from the chat.

interface.longDescription:
pencil.md turns markdown into a shareable page in one step, with no signup. With this plugin ChatGPT can publish what you are working on as a clean, readable page (pencil.md/abc12345), send you the link, and edit the page later when you ask for changes. It can also upload images, build drawings on the infinite canvas at draw.pencil.md (live-markdown text, shapes, arrows, freehand strokes, images), list everything you have published, password-protect pages, and hand you a one-time link that signs any browser in so you can edit the same pages by hand.

Everything the plugin publishes belongs to your anonymous pencil.md identity — there are no accounts, no tracking and no ads. Pages are public to anyone with the link unless you protect them with a password. Disconnect the plugin at any time to revoke its access; your pages stay online until you delete them.
defaultPrompt: Publish these notes to pencil.md and give me the link.
Turn this conversation into a pencil.md page with headings and a summary.
Make a pencil.md drawing of this architecture with boxes and arrows.
Update my pencil.md page about the launch plan with the new dates.
